name: motion-livre
description: Editor de motion design aberto e offline para Windows
author: Motion Livre Contributors

scripts.test:core: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:renderer && node tools/test-animation-core.cjs && node tools/test-clip-commands-core.cjs && node tools/test-editor-state.cjs && node tools/test-selection-commands.cjs && node tools/test-freeze-frame.cjs && node tools/test-history-core.cjs && node tools/test-preview-quality.cjs && node tools/test-project-model-core.cjs && node tools/test-project-session.cjs && node tools/test-project-commands.cjs && node tools/test-media-commands.cjs && node tools/test-export-controller.cjs && node tools/test-export-ipc.cjs && node tools/test-media-lifecycle.cjs && node tools/test-proxy-cache.cjs && node tools/test-time-mapping.cjs && node tools/test-export-audio.cjs && node tools/test-export-audio-seams.cjs && node tools/test-export-audio-timestamps.cjs && node tools/test-export-mix.cjs && node tools/test-proxy-real.cjs && node tools/test-frame-export.cjs
scripts.test:renderer: electron tools/test-renderer-contracts.cjs && electron tools/test-editing-commands.cjs && electron tools/test-alight-xml.cjs
scripts.dev: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:ui && concurrently --kill-others "vite build --watch" "electron ."
scripts.dist: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:ui && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/prepare-runtime.ps1 && electron-builder --projectDir .build/runtime --win nsis portable --x64 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/clean-dist.ps1
